note: Passages only. BEMIS is by the plan's own words an annual census. The School Information System is the one system schools feed in real time, but the passages say only that schools and ward officers 'capture data': nothing says the data are records per learner (attendance, results or enrolment), so it is left unclassified and gives no fact. The plan also contradicts itself on whether SIS is still being tested or already covers all regions.
